note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a per-episode key bag (2206 distinct key sets over 1365 distinct keys across 2222 records), so the datasets-server infers a small `reward` struct from the first shard and then cannot cast later shards that add keys such as `http_403s` or `pager_last_row_still_broken`; declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; 37 distinct keys across 29707 calls, and two keys vary in value type (`path` is a string on 2272 calls and a list of point pairs on 1, `seconds` is an int on 1239 and a float on 1)

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 2991 of 29707 steps; always a string where present

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` and `cost_steps` on every record, plus a per-episode tail of selector/overlay/HTTP counters (`selector_retries`, `overlay_dismissals`, `api_fallback`, `http_429s`, `http_403s`, `pager_last_row_still_broken`, ...) -- 1365 distinct keys forming 2206 distinct key sets over 2222 records; `success` is the only bool, every other value is an int

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator`, `kind` on every record (`kind` reads `episode` on 2220 and `designed` on the two observability leftovers), `designed` and `seed` on 2220, `site` on 2212, plus `domain`, `stack`, `service`, `dashboard`, `lie` carried in only by the ten foreign leftover-mill records

disclosures.summary: Ten records are leftover mill from other factories, not browser selector-fail/retry episodes: eight carry `meta.factory` `search-index-rebuild-factory` (in `batch-r650.jsonl` through `batch-r653.jsonl`) and two carry `observability-debug-factory` (in `batch-r649.jsonl`). The other 2212 records are `browser-tool-use-factory`. They are kept exactly as generated; the raw JSONL is not rewritten.

disclosures: These ten are the `factory_mix` class defined by the shared payload-first leftover-mill classifier (issue #43 / PR #88). That PR's frozen `PUBLISHED_FACTORY_MIX` census covers only the thirty ids of four other destinations and deliberately excludes this one, so the ten ids are owned and disclosed here.
All 2222 records share one top-level key set -- `id`, `goal`, `plan`, `steps`, `outcome`, `reward`, `meta` -- so no top-level field is optional here, and every record was generated by `grok-4.6`.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
